name: StrokeCap
brief: Stroke cap style for line endings.
description: Determines the shape of the endpoints of open paths when stroked.

members.name: Butt
members.brief: Flat cap at the exact endpoint (no extension)

members.name: Round
members.brief: Rounded cap extending beyond the endpoint by half the stroke width

members.name: Square
members.brief: Square cap extending beyond the endpoint by half the stroke width
